purpose: Freeze and reconstruct the pre-Aweswell hotel phases so later conduct can be tested against the state of ownership, operation, governance and transaction rights that existed immediately before each transition.

structures.name: Sun Group
structures.boundary: Historical commercial/group label associated by later sector reporting with the Sun Park/Sun Royal/Sun Beach/Sun Island/Sun Tropical cluster. It is not itself a legal person or proof of title/control of every hotel.

structures.name: Sun Park hotel / hotel economic unit
structures.boundary: Physical/operating hotel object distinct from any one legal owner, finca, operating vehicle or owners' community.

structures.name: San Hotels
structures.boundary: User-supplied historical label. Current targeted web/repository/Drive review has not independently reconciled it to Sun Group, JSP or another legal/commercial structure; do not promote it as an alias until a source bridge is located.

objectives.name: 2008 acquisition of the hotel as a unified economic/operating object
objectives.boundary: Transaction object/intention and market description must be separated from finca-by-finca legal completion.

objectives.name: 2011 acquisition of the Multimatrix/LPB position by the UK holdco
objectives.boundary: Primary corporate/share chain controls; does not itself transfer every extraneous third-party right.

source_controls.description: Recovered tourism ficha records SUN PARK, Calle Janubio/parcela G, Costa Papagayo, authorization 15-May-1991 and 220 accommodation units.
source_controls.boundary: Administrative authorization is a hard operational/classification anchor; exact construction completion and first guest/opening date remain separate.

source_controls.description: Tourinews 6-May-2022 associates José Sánchez Rodríguez/JSP with design/construction of five Playa Blanca complexes grouped as Sun Group at the beginning of the 1990s.
source_controls.boundary: Later secondary history; not a title deed or exact opening-date source.

source_controls.description: 26-May-2008 operating-cession recital distinguishes 220 apartments owned by their respective owners from 40 commercial/service premises and two pools attributed to Monte Lanza, and describes Monte Lanza's historical hotel operation.
source_controls.boundary: Contract recital/source statement; title must be checked finca-by-finca.

source_controls.description: Alimarket 16-Jul-2008 reported that Monte Lanza reached a June agreement with Multimatrix to transfer ownership and operation of Aparthotel Sun Park (3E-220 apartments), with property acquired through Luchy and operation through CEXP.
source_controls.boundary: Market-level description of the hotel transaction; not proof that all 262 fincas or all seller rights completed.

source_controls.description: Multimatrix-commissioned impairment study dated 24-Mar-2010 states that on 18-Jun-2008 Multimatrix, through foreign subsidiaries, purchased Sun Park rights/activities comprising 171 units, 29 facility areas and hotel management rights for EUR11.8m.
source_controls.boundary: Near-contemporaneous buyer-side commissioned report; strong perimeter evidence but not substitute for every underlying conveyance.

source_controls.description: 15-Jul-2008 CEXP/transaction-period minutes place LPB with 171 apartments and 29 commercial properties and Monte Lanza with 11 commercial properties.
source_controls.boundary: Located meeting record; governance/authority and complete native/minutes-book chain remain source-specific.

source_controls.description: Monte Lanza 2008/2012 account family records 2008 asset sales/options, residual 11-premises option and later 2009/2010 dispositions; controlled review records JSP direct shareholding at 26.82% at end-2008.
source_controls.boundary: Company accounts evidence; direct 26.82% shareholding is not proof of absence or presence of indirect/de facto control.

source_controls.description: 3-Jan-2012 Spanish deed records that Monterecco Sun Park Limited acquired all shares in LPB from Multimatrix Limited under a Tel Aviv notarial deed dated 1-Dec-2011 and apostilled.
source_controls.boundary: Controls the LPB share succession; complete wider economic-rights chain remains separately testable.

source_controls.description: BORME-C-2017-7368 records JSP shareholders requesting further explanations concerning the 'venta del Complejo Sun Park' and majority sale of Explobeach, expanding explanations given at prior general meetings.
source_controls.boundary: Confirms the sale remained a corporate-history subject; does not itself prove purchaser, price, exact asset perimeter or wrongdoing.

source_controls.description: Signed 29-Apr-2008 extraordinary owners' meeting minutes for the CEXP formation/reorganisation. The reviewed source records an earlier 18-Feb-2008 owners' resolution/option context, separately lists JSP and Monte Lanza as represented owners, and records a 74.90% approval for the operating-community structure.
source_controls.boundary: Signed minutes with later signature legitimation are evidence of the recorded meeting and resolutions, not the missing 18-Feb original mandate, the underlying option instrument, every proxy/title, or 100% individual conveyance consent.

source_controls.description: LPB interim financial review as at 30-Sep-2009 describes 29 premises plus two pools/ancillary areas acquired from Monte Lanza and use of 11 premises still belonging to Monte Lanza, with an expected further purchase at the end of 2010.
source_controls.boundary: Limited financial review, not an audit or conveyance instrument. It supports the residual-asset state but does not establish legal enforceability, exercise or release of the underlying option.

source_controls.description: Monte Lanza deposited-account family records a 17-Jun-2008 asset sale, a same-date option over 11 unsold premises expiring 31-Dec-2010, later 2009 sales and 2010 in-kind transfers to shareholders/creditors, and later option accounting.
source_controls.boundary: Retrospective company-account disclosures. They do not replace the original contracts, deeds, corporate approvals, recipient-level title evidence or any release/waiver instrument.

source_controls.description: A 13-Dec-2011 accountant/tax-adviser diagnostic prepared for the incoming project principals described LPB cash-flow pressure, 2009-2010 unit-sale activity, CP/CEXP conflicts, non-participating owners and proposed acquisition/agreement solutions.
source_controls.boundary: Contemporaneous adviser analysis and reported management/accounting figures; not an audit, adjudicated finding, or independent proof of every debt, unit sale, authority dispute or causal proposition.

source_controls.description: A final-form share-purchase agreement copy transmitted on 28-Nov-2011 describes LPB as owning 159 of 220 accommodation units and 29 public areas, Multimatrix as holder of 100% of LPB shares and a controlling CEXP stake, and proposed transfer to Monterecco Sun Park Limited of the LPB shares plus specified wider claims/rights.
source_controls.boundary: The reviewed copy is strong contemporaneous evidence of intended/final-form terms and the pre-closing state. Its reviewed signature page is blank, so this copy is NOT execution proof. The 1-Dec-2011 Tel Aviv notarial share transfer remains the primary execution anchor; wider claims/right assignments require separate executed-source proof.

source_controls.description: A 15-Dec-2011 source-handover communication to the incoming project principals supplied CEXP historical records including constitution/agreements/statutes, tax setup and 2008-2010 member/tax materials.
source_controls.boundary: Proves a contemporaneous records handover/provenance event. Receipt does not authenticate every enclosed document, prove legal effectiveness of every CEXP act, or establish knowledge beyond the material actually supplied.

source_controls.description: Immediately after the project-side acquisition, a third-party lawyer asserted that a creditor had an outstanding loan, claimed security over LPB shares and/or a second-mortgage position, and sought assurance of repayment/security from the incoming side.
source_controls.boundary: Third-party assertion only. It does not establish the debt, lien, profit-sharing entitlement, buyer assumption or default. Underlying loan/security instruments and any settlement are required before promoting the claimant into the public canonical actor graph.

source_controls.description: A March-2012 accountant response quantified asserted LPB obligations to Multimatrix in separate service and funding categories.
source_controls.boundary: Contemporaneous accounting statement, not an independent audit or proof that every asserted balance was legally due, assigned to Aweswell, recognised in Concurso 36/2012 or unrepaid.

source_controls.description: Early-2012 correspondence preserved links and a note concerning possible Multimatrix liquidation/financing developments in Israel.
source_controls.boundary: Research lead only. The linked Israeli corporate/market records have not been independently authenticated in this graph and no liquidation status or effect on the 2011 transfer is inferred.

events.evidence_boundary: The signed 29-Apr minutes record an earlier 18-Feb owners' resolution/option context. The original 18-Feb ACTA, attendance/proxy annex, mandate denominator and underlying option remain missing; later attendance is not back-projected.

events.evidence_boundary: Signed minutes establish the recorded CEXP/operating reorganisation and 74.90% approval among those recorded present/represented. They are not a conveyance, do not prove 100% individual seller consent, and do not prove every proxy/title or the missing 18-Feb mandate.
events.recorded_approval_percentage: 74.90% of owners present or represented, as recorded in the minutes

events.evidence_boundary: Operating handover and consideration do not prove completion of the whole real-estate sale.

events.transaction_object_as_reported: Aparthotel Sun Park, property and operation, 3E-220 apartments
events.evidence_boundary: This freezes what the transaction was presented as in contemporaneous trade press: the hotel. It is not promoted to proof that every title/right completed.

events.completed_perimeter_reported: 171 accommodation units + 29 facility areas + hotel management rights; EUR11.8m consideration
events.evidence_boundary: Buyer-side report demonstrates a materially smaller acquired perimeter than the whole 220-unit hotel object described by Alimarket; underlying deeds govern legal completion.

events.state: LPB recorded with 171 apartments and 29 commercial properties; Monte Lanza recorded with 11 commercial properties.
events.evidence_boundary: This discrepancy is a central state transition and must remain visible rather than being flattened into either 'whole hotel sold' or 'only part was ever intended'.

asset_state.pre_sale_company_property: 40 commercial/service premises + 2 pools, as recited in the controlled 26-May operating instrument
asset_state.residual_supported: 11 commercial/service premises retained by Monte Lanza and subject to a later-purchase/option framework

events.evidence_boundary: Seller accounts and the later LPB review corroborate a 29+2 acquired / 11 residual company-property split. The original sale deed, residual-option instrument, exercise/assignment/release chain and finca annexes remain controlling for legal completion.

phase_freezes.truth_machine_rule: Preserve both layers: WHOLE HOTEL AS TRANSACTION OBJECT / INTENTION / MARKET REPRESENTATION versus LESS-THAN-WHOLE COMPLETED LEGAL/ECONOMIC PERIMETER. Investigate the bridge and why the intended/marketed state did not match the post-completion state.

later sales, shareholder in-kind settlements and expiry/dispute of residual rights/options

state.lpb_company_property: 29 premises + 2 pools/ancillary areas described as acquired from Monte Lanza
state.monte_lanza_residual: 11 premises described as still belonging to Monte Lanza, with use continuing and expected further purchase at end-2010

events.evidence_boundary: Limited financial review supplies a contemporaneous buyer-side state description, not conveyance title or proof that the contemplated end-2010 purchase was legally mandatory or completed.

Later Monte Lanza accounts disclose 2009 sales. Exact fincas, purchasers, prices, authority and interaction with earlier buyer rights/options remain unverified and must be reconstructed transaction by transaction.

Later company accounts describe in-kind property transfers to shareholders/creditors in settlement of company debt. This is not automatically a liquidation distribution and does not establish recipient, finca, valuation, prior-buyer consent or release of any earlier option.

asset_state.lpb_accommodation_units: 159 of 220, as represented in the transmitted final-form SPA copy
asset_state.lpb_public_areas: 29, as represented in the transmitted final-form SPA copy
asset_state.transition_from_2008: Consistent with the later documented 171 initial apartments minus 12 prior apartment disposals; exact 12-finca sale crosswalk remains separately controlled.

events.wider_rights_terms_as_drafted: The transmitted final-form copy contemplated transfer, alongside LPB shares, of specified past/current/future claims or debt rights asserted by Multimatrix and Sun Energy Spaces against LPB, CEXP and the owners' Community.
events.evidence_boundary: Do not call this reviewed copy an executed SPA. Its blank signature page is affirmative source evidence that this particular copy does not prove execution. The 1-Dec-2011 Tel Aviv notarial share transfer controls executed shareholder succession; execution/scope of the wider claims-rights package remains open.

phase_freezes.label: UK holdco succeeds to the Multimatrix/LPB position

events.state: Monterecco Sun Park Limited (same UK company later renamed AWESWELL LIMITED) acquired all LPB shares from Multimatrix Limited under the recited Tel Aviv deed.
events.evidence_boundary: Executed shareholder succession is controlled by the 1-Dec-2011 Tel Aviv notarial transfer as later publicised in Spain. The 28-Nov final-form copy independently illuminates the pre-closing asset/corporate state and proposed wider rights package but, because its reviewed signature page is blank, does not prove execution of those wider terms.
Spanish deed/publicity records the prior 1-Dec-2011 share transfer and administration change; it is not the sale of every hotel finca.

Contemporaneous adviser diagnostic records the problems being presented to the incoming principals—cash-flow pressure, prior unit-sale activity, CP/CEXP conflict and the possible acquisition/agreement solution. It is not an audit or adjudication of those propositions.

Shows that incoming principals requested/received a historical CEXP document package soon after shareholder succession. It does not authenticate each enclosed record or prove legal effectiveness of every historical CEXP act.

A third party asserted debt/security/profit-related rights immediately after the acquisition. No merits admission is inferred from the incoming side's acknowledgement/response; underlying instruments and any settlement must be produced.

open_gaps.target: Primary building completion/first opening/first guest/operating licence chronology; distinguish 1988 works reference, c.1989-90 recollection and 15-May-1991 tourism authorization.
Find source proving or disproving the user-supplied 'San Hotels' label and its relationship, if any, to Sun Group/JSP.
Reconstruct direct/indirect/de facto control and shareholder genealogy without converting 26.82% direct year-end 2008 JSP holding into an unsupported majority claim.

Recover the original 18-Feb-2008 owners' ACTA/mandate, attendance and proxy annex, exact authority denominator and the underlying Victory Properties option. The signed 29-Apr minutes now corroborate that an earlier option/resolution existed but do not supply the missing instrument.

Recover signed 12-Mar option, 17-Jun exercise/assignment/sale and same-date residual 11-premises option, plus notices, amendments, expiry/release/waiver and consideration. Seller accounts and buyer-side review now narrow the asset split but do not close the legal instrument chain.
Finca-by-finca crosswalk from the whole-hotel transaction object to the 171+29 completed perimeter and every retained/failed/contested unit or right.

Build finca-by-finca ledger for the disclosed 2009 sales, 2010 in-kind debt settlements and the 12 LPB apartment disposals that bridge 171 apartments to the 159 represented immediately before the 2011 succession. Capture buyer/recipient, date, price/valuation, authority, debt effect, notice/consent and interaction with residual options.
Certify legal identity bridge among Multimatrix Ltd., Multimatrix Limited and Multimatrix Investments Ltd. source literals.

The 28-Nov-2011 final-form SPA copy is now recovered and its reviewed signature page is blank. Obtain the executed 1-Dec closing package and determine whether/how the drafted wider claims/right transfers (including Multimatrix/Sun Energy Spaces claims against LPB/CEXP/CP) were executed, assigned, valued, paid, retained or later asserted.

Recover the underlying third-party loan/security/profit-sharing instruments asserted immediately after closing, identify the exact claimant and collateral, determine whether any buyer assumption existed, and trace settlement/release/enforcement. Do not canonically publish the claimant from private correspondence alone.

Acquire/authenticate the original Israeli corporate/market records underlying the early-2012 Multimatrix liquidation/financing lead and reconcile them to the exact Israeli Multimatrix legal person involved in the 2008/2011 chain.

Crosswalk the 15-Dec-2011 CEXP handover package document-by-document into the canonical source graph, preserving authenticity/status separately from receipt and mapping what the incoming principals actually had before each early-2012 decision.

no_regression: Do not reset Sun Park history to 2008, 2011, 2012 or 2018.
Do not convert Alimarket's whole-hotel market description into proof that all fincas transferred.
Do not convert the 171+29 completed perimeter into a claim that only part of the hotel was ever intended to be purchased.
Do not describe JSP as direct majority shareholder of Monte Lanza at end-2008 on current controlled accounts.
Do not promote 'San Hotels' to a canonical alias absent a source bridge.
Do not treat Multimatrix, LPB, CEXP, Monte Lanza, Sun Group or the hotel economic unit as the same legal object.
Do not create a separate legal person for MONTERECCO SUN PARK LIMITED; it is the former name of AWESWELL LIMITED, UK company no. 07716847.

post_handoff_corroboration.boundary: Accounting statement only; do not treat as an adjudicated or automatically transferred Aweswell claim.
